target_translation: RULEBOOK 0.7(b) (RULEBOOK.md:319, names SPI result sets): no bump arena and no &Arena anywhere in the object. `allocator_` (ob_spi.h:279) is removed: the StmtSavedValue objects become `orign_session_value_ / cursor_session_value_ / nested_session_value_: Option<Box<StmtSavedValue>>` via try_box in alloc_saved_value (ob_spi.cpp:228-239, failure -> OB_ALLOCATE_MEMORY_FAILED); reset() (ob_spi.h:187-216) resets then drops them; the SQL copies (ob_spi.cpp:2732-2733) and exec_params_str_ (h:293, filled at :4310) become owned bytes of the SPI result set, one `Box<[u8]>` each (interim, see TODO). `buf_` + placement-new `result_set_` (h:282-283; ob_spi.cpp:127-129; reset_member_for_retry h:217-231) -> `result_set_: Option<Box<ObResultSet>>` with ObResultSet in its owned form (no 'q): its types.tsv lifetime_class is empty, so RULEBOOK §5.3 生命周期类别不明 -> 长生命周期（拥有型） (RULEBOOK.md:1105); `~ObResultSet()` -> drop. `mem_context_` + `mem_context_destroy_guard_` (h:275,278; child of CURRENT_CONTEXT ob_spi.cpp:124-125) are removed: a MemCtx owns a bump Arena (api/01 §2.4) and nothing reads this context's hold, so api/01 §2.12's MemoryContext-member row gives "其余拥有型"; the parent-tree accounting it fed is the accepted A.4 query-mem-limit difference. The arena arguments taken from it (inner_open ob_spi.cpp:2751,2766,2878; store_params_value_to_str :4310) are dropped for what the cursor keeps (owned), and the WITH_CONTEXT(spi_result.get_memory_ctx()) blocks (:140, :4464, :4527) run with the caller's explicit MemCtx for transient work (depends-on:01-mem@L12). Send only: the GV$OPEN_CURSOR reader holds the session's thread-data latch (ob_virtual_open_cursor_table.cpp:139) and Latch<T> is Sync for T: Send (api/02 §2.2). TODO(port): 1d provides no 0.7(b) owned chunk buffer / RowId type (RULEBOOK.md:319); the byte copies use one Box<[u8]> each until it exists. TODO(port): ObResultSet's lifetime class is undecided - it is a request-frame SMART_VAR (obmp_query.cpp:805) and is also kept across calls by ObSPIResultSet, ObInnerSQLResult (ob_inner_sql_result.cpp:91-92) and PLPrepareResult (ob_spi.cpp:105-109); the §5.3 owned default is applied, which also makes the c04 row ObResultSet::mem_pool_ REMOVE_ALLOC: a human confirms or splits ObResultSet into two types.
